minutes.headline: Sewer Commission hired Woodard and Curran for an I and I study; a separate meeting will take up the Small Water contract dispute.
minutes.summary: The commission heard an early request to bring a Crossroad parcel into the sewer district, and a request to abate a betterment on a house converted from two-family to single-family. It voted to issue a contract for an infiltration and inflow study and to ask the selectmen to fill two vacancies. A separate posted meeting was set to settle what the Small Water contract covers and when Small Water may bill extra.

public_comment.topic: A resident asked why the town is paying for an I and I study when a DEP standard exists, and how big the problem is.
Urged residents to apply for the two open Sewer Commission seats and thanked the departing chair.

votes.motion: Issue a contract to Woodard and Curran per the proposal for the I and I study.
Submit the commission vacancy to the selectmen for advertising and filling.
Name Carl Luck as liaison to Leominster for IMA discussions.

budget_items.topic: Woodard and Curran I and I study proposal
budget_items.what_was_said: The consultant said the estimate includes some supplemental fieldwork that may not be needed, depending on the quality of the town's GIS data.

budget_items.topic: Cost of I and I study and next I and I phase
budget_items.what_was_said: A resident put the study bid at about forty thousand. A member said the next I and I phase could cost a couple hundred thousand dollars over several years.
The agent said the betterment was assessed as a two-family and the owners want it adjusted after conversion to single-family. Members said the abatement window is six months.

budget_items.topic: Small Water call-out billing outside the contract
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said Small Water billed labor for work they believe the contract already covers, and asked for two years of invoices.
Leominster said by phone that an invoice for its capital improvement section of the IMA is coming, which surprised the business manager.
The chair was asked to initial a Fitchburg invoice.

A posted meeting next week, with the DPW director and the business manager, will cover what the Small Water contract covers and when Small Water can bill outside it.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to issue a contract to Woodard and Curran for an infiltration and inflow (I and I) study.
The commission voted to submit its vacancies to the selectmen for advertising and filling.
A posted meeting next week, with the DPW director and business manager, will settle what the Small Water contract covers and when Small Water may bill outside it.
The commission voted to name Carl Luck liaison to Leominster for IMA discussions; Leominster said an invoice for its capital improvement section is coming.
A betterment abatement request for a house converted from two-family to single-family was left unresolved, and the Crossroad parcel request awaits the engineer's documentation.

why_it_matters: The I and I study is the first step in finding clean water leaking into the sewer system, work that can lead to larger multi-year repair costs carried by sewer ratepayers.
Disputed Small Water billing outside its contract and a coming Leominster invoice are charges that can reach sewer bills, and two open commission seats are a chance for residents to take part.
watch_next: The posted meeting next week on the Small Water contract, with the DPW director and business manager.
The engineer's return to the commission with the documentation on the Crossroad parcel, and the owners' written case on the betterment abatement.
